label: UniFi XG
description: The 10G access point: one GbE port and one 1/10 GbE ICM port, 4x4 on 5 GHz at 1733 Mbps. Needs a PoE++ injector - it will not run from 802.3af.
notes: Vendor figures: (1) GbE RJ45 port and (1) 1/10 GbE ICM Ethernet port; max data rate 1733 Mbps on 5 GHz (4x4) and 450 Mbps on 2.4 GHz (3x3); power method: Gigabit PoE++ adapter 50V DC 1.2A. The second port is the 10G ICM interface, modelled at 10G.
